name: breadcrumbs-slash-trail
title: Breadcrumbs Slash Trail
description: An accessible trail of hierarchy waypoints separated by slash delimiters indicating current route depth.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Hierarchical Wayfinding: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
